mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 61 degrees and clear at Reddan Soccer Park, with the moon currently in its first quarter phase.

The city is actively recruiting an Engineering Technician to oversee municipal construction projects through September 20. Additionally, the city has updated its sewer and stormwater utility rates to maintain infrastructure and prevent service failures.

Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market. There is also plenty of live music scheduled for today at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can check out the Girls Try Hockey event tomorrow at the Verona Ice Arena.
Regarding the weekly report, on Friday, a 29-year-old man was arrested for his second O W I and cited for failing to install an ignition interlock device.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Raspberry Cheesecake. Since Culver's is currently closed, please note they will reopen at 10 AM, and tomorrow's featured flavor will be Caramel Cashew.
